en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a massive fortified wall with prominent towers and a tall minaret-like structure rising in the background. Scattered individuals in traditional attire can be seen walking on the grounds in front of the complex. The text at the top reads '75 - MEKNES — Ancien Palais de Mouley-Ismaïl — LL'. The overall aesthetic suggests a historical or early 20th-century production.
